coverage_decisions.decision: Reviewed PMT summary and all five SR Matter pages against 4.3. Existing displacement, heating curve and two-stage heating example retained. Added density error direction/graph axes, partial-melt mass and gas-condition comparison. Rejected fixed tenfold particle spacing, compressibility caused merely by free movement, unqualified pressure proportional to Celsius temperature, and compression always increasing temperature. Advanced variable-pressure work integrals are outside this course.
